an6.88:1.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto pi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
an6.88:1.3: Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, anatthaṃ gaṇhāti, atthaṃ riñcati, ananulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato hoti.
an6.88:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto pi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ. 3.
an6.88:2.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto pi saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
an6.88:2.3: Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne sussūsati, sotaṃ odahati, aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, atthaṃ gaṇhāti, anatthaṃ riñcati, anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato hoti.
an6.88:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto pi saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu samattan
